project_meta.brand_name: TEK CAR Mecânica de Alta Precisão
project_meta.tone: Senior, técnico, sóbrio, cirúrgico, confiável e editorial. Rejeição explícita a clichês de IA, badges excessivos, dashboards desnecessários e luzes neon.
project_meta.theme: Dark Theme Premium (Preto profundo com nuances de azul-marinho muito escuro, toques de cinza titânio e vermelho de precisão cirúrgica).

design_intent.persona_and_craft: E1 Senior Designer reconstruction. High-end automotive craft inspired by German engineering publications and editorial precision mechanics. Emphasizes visual continuum, generous white space (2-3x typical density), real workshop photography, and tactile typography.
avoid_patterns: No neon glow borders or cheap CSS box-shadow explosions
No template cards with equal repetitive heights and boring icons inside colored circles
No dashboard analytics or fake tech graphs
No ALL-CAPS body or headings (UPPERCASE reserved strictly for tiny overlines/eyebrows with tracking-[0.2em])
No saturated red backgrounds for entire sections - red is used exclusively for primary CTAs, active states, and surgical focal accents

hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-white leading-tight

layout_and_spacing.section_rhythm: Alternating narrative flow with breathing room: Hero (cinematic full-bleed with text) -> Trust Strip (refined continuous bar) -> Services (asymmetric spacious grid) -> Differentials (editorial 2-column image/story) -> Structure (large real equipment photo + precision points) -> Process (numbered 01-04 connected timeline) -> Google Reviews (clean authentic cards) -> Location & Workshop Hours (dark stylized coordinates + map + directions) -> Final Conversion Strip -> Minimal Footer
layout_and_spacing.mobile_rules: No desktop squeezing. Touch-friendly CTA buttons (min-height 48px), clean full-width stacked views, dedicated mobile slide-over nav, comfortable 16px body type.

accessibility_and_testing.wcag_aa_compliance: High contrast ratio (> 5.5:1) for text against dark surfaces, large tap targets (minimum 44x44px), explicit focus rings and visible keyboard navigation.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Strictly follow the dark titanium/deep navy palette (#0A0D12, #0F141C, #141B24). Never turn it into a standard flat generic grey.
Do NOT use repetitive equal-height generic SaaS cards. Emphasize asymmetry, generous spacing (p-8, py-20 to py-28) and real workshop photo presence.

The primary red (#E5252A) must be applied with surgical restraint: CTA buttons, small active indicators, key typography accent line in H1, and active states. DO NOT tint whole section backgrounds with red.
Ensure header uses translucent dark background (#0A0D12 with 85% opacity + backdrop-blur-md) with 1px delicate metallic border to prevent text collision when scrolling over page content.

Provide clear interactive elements with proper testids: modals for scheduling with vehicle inputs, direct WhatsApp links with pre-filled respectful messages in Portuguese, copy address feature, and working responsive navigation.
